- **Paper:** The potential of elemental analysis in determining origin of sawfish rostra
- **DOI:** tbd
- **Written:** 28 Aug 2026 (all three sets, all six elements, Oct 2026)
- **Content:** dynamic time warping III: build the match up along the vertebra, window by window

The original version is in `original/06c_dtw_warpup.R`.
For each version (06c), with 500 µm vertebra windows every 200 µm, 
each allowed to match 1–12 µm of tooth per µm of vertebra (15 steps, tooth starts every 200 µm).
Each window picks its own growth ratio, since it's expected to change along the vertebra (early
in life, a µm of vertebra probably relates to more tooth than later). Both records use only 06a's rolling medians (no further smoothing):

1. **Build from the anchor**: the first window of the anchor (where the version's anchor
   elements start out close and keep a steady, parallel slope, 06c) is matched with its
   tooth piece. From there the build goes one forward, each piece starting later on
   the tooth than the last, and backward, each starting earlier, so it can only add to the alignment.
   
   Each direction stops when there's no tooth left, or where the tooth doesn't align to the vertebra at all: 
   near flat (ratio 100 per 500) or near vertical (5000 µm per 100 µm).

2. **All elements over the built-out stretch**: one `match_window()` over the whole stretch the build reached + its figure.

3. **Random order, within that stretch**: the same windows, each free to match anywhere on the tooth. 

4. **Build vs random**: Where they overlap by at least half (of the shorter piece).

Versions without an anchor, or whose build fails, are skipped and listed, so the rest still run. Starts from 06a and 06c2 (`data/output/dtw_cache/06a.RData`, `06c2.RData`); saves `06d.RData` for 06f and 06g.

source('helpers/microHelp.R')

## Settings

```{r settings}
up_settings <- list(win = 750, step = 200, ratio_range = c(1, 8), n_ratios = 16,
                    start_step = 200,        # um between candidate tooth starts (match_window's default is 100)
                    overlap = 0.45,           # build and random agree if their tooth pieces overlap by this share
                    final_elements = c("Mg_Ca_mav", "Sr_Ca_mav", "Ba_Ca_mav", "Mn_Ca_mav", "Zn_Ca_mav"),  # step 2 uses all but Li bc bleh
                    # stop building where the tooth doesn't align to the vertebra at all:
                    flat  = c(vert = 750, tooth = 250),    # near flat: tooth moves less than this over this much vertebra (R < .5)
                    steep = c(vert = 500, tooth = 12500))   # near vertical: tooth moves more than this over this much vertebra

# to set an anchor by hand, e.g.: anchors$SMA002W1 <- c(5000, 6000)
ok <- sapply(names(sets), function(n) length(anchors[[n]]) == 2)
skipped <- data.frame(version = names(sets)[!ok], reason = rep("no anchor from 06c2", sum(!ok)))
sets <- sets[ok]

# one window of one version, with its anchor elements (each record prepared once, then reused)
preps <- lapply(setNames(names(sets), names(sets)), function(n)
  prep_records(sets[[n]]$tooth, sets[[n]]$vert, anchor_pairs[[n]], gap_um = gap_um))
# start = where the tooth piece may start (default: anywhere)
mw <- function(n, v, start = c(-Inf, Inf))
  cbind(set = n, match_window(sets[[n]]$tooth, sets[[n]]$vert, anchor_pairs[[n]], v_from = v, win = up_settings$win,
                              ratio_range = up_settings$ratio_range, n_ratios = up_settings$n_ratios, start_search = start, gap_um = gap_um,
                              prep = preps[[n]], start_step = up_settings$start_step))
starts <- function(n) seq(min(sets[[n]]$vert$true_dist), max(sets[[n]]$vert$true_dist) - up_settings$win,
                          by = up_settings$step)
```

## 1. Build from the anchor

```{r build}
build <- function(n){
  v_all <- starts(n); a_rng <- anchors[[n]]
  # seed: the window nearest the anchor's start, its tooth piece starting in the anchor's tooth stretch
  v0 <- v_all[which.min(abs(v_all - a_rng[1]))]
  a  <- mw(n, v0, anchor_tooth[[n]])
  if(is.na(a$tooth_start)) stop("no match inside the anchor")
  # build one way from the seed, one window at a time, each piece starting on from the last
  # (never back). Stop when no tooth is left to match, or where the path goes near flat or near
  # vertical: how far the tooth moved since the latest window at least flat/steep "vert" um back.
  # The windows past that one are dropped
  build_dir <- function(vs, edge, forward){
    out <- list(); hist <- data.frame(v = v0, t = edge); why <- "end of vertebra"   # hist row 1 = the seed
    for(v in vs){
      r <- mw(n, v, if(forward) c(edge, Inf) else c(-Inf, edge))
      if(is.na(r$tooth_start)){ why <- "no tooth left"; break }
      out[[length(out) + 1]] <- r
      hist <- rbind(hist, data.frame(v = v, t = r$tooth_start))
      back <- function(um) max(c(0, which(abs(v - hist$v) >= um)))   # 0 = not that far from the seed yet
      j <- back(up_settings$flat[["vert"]])
      if(j && abs(r$tooth_start - hist$t[j]) < up_settings$flat[["tooth"]]){
        out <- head(out, j - 1); why <- "near flat"; break }
      j <- back(up_settings$steep[["vert"]])
      if(j && abs(r$tooth_start - hist$t[j]) > up_settings$steep[["tooth"]]){
        out <- head(out, j - 1); why <- "near vertical"; break }
      edge <- r$tooth_start
    }
    list(rows = do.call(rbind, out), why = why)
  }
  f <- build_dir(v_all[v_all > v0], a$tooth_start, TRUE)          # later vert, later tooth
  k <- build_dir(rev(v_all[v_all < v0]), a$tooth_start, FALSE)    # earlier vert, earlier tooth
  b <- rbind(k$rows, a, f$rows)
  b <- b[order(b$v_from), ]
  b$stage <- ifelse(b$v_from >= a_rng[1] & b$v_from <= a_rng[2], "anchor", ifelse(b$v_from < v0, "backward", "forward"))
  attr(b, "stopped") <- c(forward = f$why, backward = k$why)
  b
}
plan(multisession, workers = min(length(sets), future::availableCores() - 1))
up <- future_map(setNames(names(sets), names(sets)), function(n) tryCatch(build(n), error = function(e) conditionMessage(e)),
                 .options = furrr_options(packages = c("dtw", "ggplot2")))
plan(sequential)
failed <- names(up)[sapply(up, is.character)]
stopped <- lapply(up[!names(up) %in% failed], attr, "stopped")
if(length(failed)) skipped <- rbind(skipped, data.frame(version = failed, reason = paste("build failed:", unlist(up[failed]))))
up <- up[!names(up) %in% failed]

# per-element results kept apart, since versions use different elements
split_els <- function(b){
  el_cols <- grep("^(cost|warp)_", names(b), value = TRUE)
  long <- do.call(rbind, lapply(unique(sub("^(cost|warp)_", "", el_cols)), function(el)
    data.frame(set = b$set, v_from = b$v_from, element = sub("_Ca.*$", "", el),
               cost = b[[paste0("cost_", el)]], warp = b[[paste0("warp_", el)]])))
  list(core = b[setdiff(names(b), el_cols)], elements = long)
}
built    <- do.call(rbind, lapply(up, function(b) split_els(b)$core))
built_el <- do.call(rbind, lapply(up, function(b) split_els(b)$elements))
built    <- built[!is.na(built$tooth_start), ]
rownames(built) <- NULL
```

```{r skipped}
if(nrow(skipped)) knitr::kable(skipped, row.names = FALSE) else cat("No versions skipped.")
```

```{r built-table}
knitr::kable(do.call(rbind, lapply(split(built, built$set), function(b) data.frame(
  version = b$set[1], elements = paste(sub("_Ca.*$", "", anchor_pairs[[b$set[1]]]), collapse = " + "),
  anchor = sprintf("%.0f-%.0f", anchors[[b$set[1]]][1], anchors[[b$set[1]]][2]),
  windows = nrow(b), vert = sprintf("%.0f-%.0f", min(b$v_from), max(b$v_to)),
  tooth = sprintf("%.0f-%.0f", min(b$tooth_start), max(b$tooth_end)),
  backward_stopped = stopped[[b$set[1]]][["backward"]], forward_stopped = stopped[[b$set[1]]][["forward"]]))),
  row.names = FALSE)
```

- **elements**: the anchor elements used to build; **anchor**: the anchor (vertebra µm); its windows are built in order like the rest.
- **windows, vert, tooth**: matched windows, and the stretch of vertebra and tooth the build reached (µm).
- **backward_stopped, forward_stopped**: why the build stopped in each direction: the end of the vertebra; no tooth left to match; near flat (the tooth moved less than `flat["tooth"]` µm over `flat["vert"]` µm of vertebra); or near vertical (more than `steep["tooth"]` µm over `steep["vert"]` µm). The windows in a flat or vertical stretch are dropped.

## 2. All six elements over the built-out stretch

```{r final, results = 'asis', fig.height = 10}
final <- list()
for(n in names(up)){
  b <- built[built$set == n, ]
  cat("\n\n###", n, "\n\n")
  final[[n]] <- cbind(set = n, match_window(sets[[n]]$tooth, sets[[n]]$vert, up_settings$final_elements,
                                            v_from = min(b$v_from), win = max(b$v_to) - min(b$v_from),
                                            ratio_range = up_settings$ratio_range,
                                            n_ratios = 24, gap_um = gap_um, plot = TRUE, bands = sets[[n]]$bands))
}
final <- do.call(rbind, lapply(final, function(f) f[c("set", "v_from", "v_to", "tooth_start", "tooth_end", "ratio",
                                                      "cost", "disagree_pct")]))
```

## 3. Random order, within the built-out stretch

```{r random}
jobs <- do.call(rbind, lapply(names(up), function(n){
  b <- built[built$set == n, ]; v <- starts(n)
  data.frame(set = n, v = v[v >= min(b$v_from) & v <= max(b$v_from)])
}))
plan(multisession, workers = future::availableCores() - 1)
rand <- future_map2_dfr(jobs$set, jobs$v, function(n, v) mw(n, v),
                        .options = furrr_options(packages = c("dtw", "ggplot2")))
plan(sequential)
rand <- rand[!grepl("^(cost|warp)_", names(rand))]
```

## 4. Build vs random

```{r compare}
cmp <- do.call(rbind, lapply(names(up), function(n){
  b <- built[built$set == n, ]; r <- rand[rand$set == n, ]
  m <- merge(b[c("v_from", "v_to", "tooth_start", "tooth_end", "stage")], r[c("v_from", "tooth_start", "tooth_end")],
             by = "v_from", suffixes = c("_build", "_rand"))
  ov <- pmax(0, pmin(m$tooth_end_build, m$tooth_end_rand) - pmax(m$tooth_start_build, m$tooth_start_rand)) /
        pmin(m$tooth_end_build - m$tooth_start_build, m$tooth_end_rand - m$tooth_start_rand)
  cbind(set = n, m, overlap = ov, agree = !is.na(ov) & ov >= up_settings$overlap,
        offset_um = abs((m$tooth_start_build + m$tooth_end_build) - (m$tooth_start_rand + m$tooth_end_rand)) / 2)
}))

agree_tab <- do.call(rbind, lapply(split(cmp, cmp$set), function(d){
  d <- d[order(d$v_from), ]; o <- d
  rl <- rle(d$agree); e <- cumsum(rl$lengths); st <- e - rl$lengths + 1
  k <- which(rl$values); k <- if(length(k)) k[which.max(rl$lengths[k])] else NA
  data.frame(version = d$set[1], windows = nrow(o),
             agree_pct = round(100 * mean(o$agree)),
             forward_pct = round(100 * mean(o$agree[o$stage == "forward"])),
             backward_pct = round(100 * mean(o$agree[o$stage == "backward"])),
             median_offset_um = round(median(o$offset_um)),
             longest_vert = if(is.na(k)) "-" else sprintf("%.0f-%.0f", d$v_from[st[k]], d$v_to[e[k]]),
             longest_tooth = if(is.na(k)) "-" else sprintf("%.0f-%.0f", min(d$tooth_start_build[st[k]:e[k]]), max(d$tooth_end_build[st[k]:e[k]])))
}))
knitr::kable(agree_tab, row.names = FALSE)
```

- **windows**: built windows compared.
- **agree_pct**: share whose tooth piece overlaps the random-order match by at least half; **forward_pct, backward_pct**: the same for each direction from the anchor.
- **median_offset_um**: median distance between the centres of the built and random tooth pieces (µm of tooth).
- **longest_vert, longest_tooth**: the longest run of consecutive agreeing windows, on the vertebra and on the tooth (µm).

```{r compare-figures, results = 'asis'}
plot_cmp <- function(n){
  d <- cmp[cmp$set == n, ]; d$v_mid <- (d$v_from + d$v_to) / 2
  ggplot(d, aes(v_mid)) +
    ggplot2::annotate("rect", xmin = anchors[[n]][1], xmax = anchors[[n]][2], ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf, fill = "grey88") +
    geom_vline(xintercept = sets[[n]]$bands, colour = "brown", linewidth = 0.3) +
    geom_linerange(aes(ymin = tooth_start_rand, ymax = tooth_end_rand), colour = "#d95f02", alpha = 0.7,
                   linewidth = 1, position = position_nudge(x = -40)) +
    geom_linerange(aes(ymin = tooth_start_build, ymax = tooth_end_build), colour = "#1b9e77", alpha = 0.7,
                   linewidth = 1, position = position_nudge(x = 40)) +
    geom_point(data = d[d$agree, ], aes(y = (tooth_start_build + tooth_end_build) / 2), size = 1.2) +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(plot.caption = element_text(hjust = 0)) +
    labs(x = "Vertebra (um)", y = "Matched tooth (um)",
         caption = paste(c(sprintf("%s, built with %s.", n, paste(sub("_Ca.*$", "", anchor_pairs[[n]]), collapse = " + ")),
           strwrap(paste(
           "Each vertebra window (500 um, every 200 um) within the built-out stretch: the tooth piece matched in",
           "random order (orange, anywhere on the tooth) and by the build from the anchor (green, each window later",
           "or earlier on the tooth than the last). Black = the two overlap by at least half. Grey = anchor; brown",
           "lines = vertebral bands."), 115)), collapse = "\n"))
}
for(n in names(up)){
  cat("\n\n###", n, "\n\n")
  print(plot_cmp(n))
}
```
